audit.why: Mel owns 1-2, even at 3, Yi from 4-5 onward. Chart matches the packet and both layers agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never mentions Golden Eclipse. It calls Rebuttal her R, so the page has no account of her actual ultimate at all — a global strike that hits every enemy carrying Overwhelm and scales with the stacks she has built on them.
audit.why: Her level-6 spike is not a reflect; it is a rangeless execute that grows the longer she has been chipping you. Yi's whole plan of 'farm through the poke' feeds exactly that stack count.
audit.corrected: Golden Eclipse written into enemyWin and focus.text with Overwhelm named; Rebuttal's 38s and Solar Snare's 11s written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer has Mel's W and E swapped throughout: Solar Snare is called (W) in six places and Rebuttal is called (R) in five. The content layer has them right, so the two layers name the same abilities differently. It also treats Rebuttal purely as a reflect.
audit.why: Rebuttal does more than reflect — Riot's text says it PREVENTS HER FROM TAKING DAMAGE and grants move speed. A full Alpha Strike plus Wuju burst into an active barrier is not merely reflected, it is entirely wasted, and at 38s on rank 1 it is a window you can simply wait out. That distinction decides every all-in in the lane.
audit.corrected: focus.text, enemyWin, tradeBad, phases[4].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.mid, breakdown.late, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1] and report[5].t re-lettered and rewritten. Solar Snare's centre root versus outer slow separated, since Highlander answers only the slow. The E root cancelling Meditate added.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the two abilities that matter sit at opposite ends of the scale.
audit.why: Solar Snare returns in 11s; Rebuttal takes 38s at rank 1. Waiting out the barrier is realistic, waiting out the root is not — the page treated them as one class of threat.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Mel's W Solar Snare — the root/slow zone is the only thing that holds you still long enough for her or a ganking jungler to punish a committed Alpha Strike, so bait or Alpha-through it before you all-in. Respect her R Rebuttal reflecting your burst, but the snare is what kills you.
edits.after: Mel's Solar Snare (E) — the root at its centre is the only thing that holds you still long enough for her or a jungler to punish a committed Alpha Strike, so bait its 11s before you all-in. Rebuttal (W) is her barrier and Golden Eclipse (R) the execute off stacked Overwhelm.

edits.before: Mel wins by chipping you out of XP/HP range with auto-attacking Q poke before you itemize and by timing her R Rebuttal to reflect your committed Alpha Strike + Wuju burst back into you, then walking away while her snare zone slows your reset.
edits.after: Mel wins by chipping you out of XP and HP range with Radiant Volley before you itemize, then timing Rebuttal (W) so your committed Alpha Strike and Wuju burst do nothing at all, and finishing you with Golden Eclipse off the Overwhelm she has stacked.

edits.before: Standing at auto range trading basics into her ranged Q, or blowing your full Alpha Strike combo while her R Rebuttal is up to reflect it.
edits.after: Standing at auto range trading basics into her ranged Q, or blowing your full Alpha Strike combo into an active Rebuttal (W) barrier.

edits.before: Highlander's move/attack speed and slow immunity let you stick through her W snare-slow and reset cooldowns off the kill.
edits.after: Highlander's 85s of speed and slow immunity let you stick through the Solar Snare slow and reset cooldowns off the kill.

edits.before: Kraken Slayer / BORK on-hit shreds her low HP, and Alpha Strike's untargetable blink dodges both her snare and her R reflect window.
edits.after: Kraken Slayer or BORK shreds her low HP, and Alpha Strike's untargetable blink carries you past the Solar Snare root and into her face.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 you stabilize hard. Max E Wuju Style for true damage that ignores her lack of armor, and use W Meditate after a trade to heal back the Q chip. At 6 Highlander is your first real fight button — its slow immunity means her W Solar Snare slow no longer kites you, and any kill refreshes it to chain.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 you stabilize hard. Max E Wuju Style for true damage that ignores her lack of armour, and use Meditate after a trade to heal back the Q chip. At 6 Highlander is your first real fight button — its slow immunity means the Solar Snare slow no longer kites you, only the centre root, and any kill refreshes it.

edits.before: At 2+ items (Kraken Slayer + BORK/Wit's End) you are a 1v9 hyper-carry into her. She has no hard CC to peel a fed Yi: you E on, Alpha Strike through her R reflect and W root, and on-hit melts her squishy frame in under a Highlander window, resetting to her team.
edits.after: At 2+ items (Kraken Slayer + BORK/Wit's End) you are a 1v9 hyper-carry into her. Solar Snare's centre root is her only real peel: you E on, Alpha Strike past it, and on-hit melts her squishy frame inside one Highlander window, resetting onto her team.

edits.before: Track her W Solar Snare (the root/slow zone) and her R Rebuttal — those are the only tools that punish your Alpha Strike commit; her Q is just poke.
edits.after: Track Solar Snare (E) on 11s and Rebuttal (W) on 38s at rank 1 — the root punishes your commit and the barrier blanks it outright. Her Q is only poke.

edits.before: Don't Alpha into her active R
edits.after: Don't Alpha into her active W

edits.before: Committing your full E+Alpha burst while Rebuttal is up reflects it back and can flip the all-in; wait the reflect out or bait it on a minion.
edits.after: Committing your full E and Alpha burst while Rebuttal is up does nothing — she takes no damage at all and reflects projectiles back; bait its 38s first.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable blink dodges her W Solar Snare and ducks her R Rebuttal reflect window if timed right. Wuju Style true damage ignores that she builds no armor; Highlander's slow immunity cancels her snare's kite; Meditate out-sustains her single-target Q poke.
edits.after: Rebuttal (W) stops her taking damage at all and reflects projectiles, so a full Alpha Strike into it is thrown away — wait out its 38s. Only Solar Snare's centre roots; Highlander's slow immunity ignores the outer slow, and that root cancels Meditate mid-channel.

edits.before: Mel's Radiant Volley (Q) poke and Rebuttal (W) zone out-range you at level 1.
edits.after: Mel's Radiant Volley (Q) poke reaches 950 against your 600 at level 1.

notes: The full layer had Mel's W and E swapped in eleven places — Solar Snare labelled (W), Rebuttal labelled (R) — while the content layer had them right, so the two layers named the same abilities differently. As a result the page never described Golden Eclipse at all: her real ultimate is a rangeless strike on everyone carrying Overwhelm, scaling with the stacks she built while poking, which is the thing 'just farm through the poke' feeds. Also corrected Rebuttal: it prevents damage entirely, it does not merely reflect, and at 38s on rank 1 it is a window you wait out.
